beats.text: Eight days after Pope Francis died, reporters caught Trump on his way to Marine One and asked who should get the job next.

beats.caption: I'd like to be pope. That would be my number one choice.
beats.label: via AP

beats.text: No pretending to think it over — he went straight for the job. Then reporters pushed him for an actual name.

beats.caption: No, I don't know. I have no preference. I—I must say we have a cardinal that
beats.label: via AP

beats.text: Turns out he already had a shortlist of exactly one, and he wasn't being subtle about the audition.

beats.caption: happens to be out of a place called New York who's very good.
beats.label: via AP
